notablePrerequisites: Stuffy Doll does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Stuffy Doll by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Stuffy Doll and Howlpack Avenger trigger.
Resolve the Stuffy Doll trigger, dealing 1 damage to the player named by it.
Resolve the Howlpack Avenger trigger, dealing 1 damage to Stuffy Doll.
Repeat from step 2.
